experiment: E9 — LightGBM Poisson vs V3 linear Poisson
missing_data_policy: median imputation for BOTH arms, medians from training-fold rows only; native NaN handling deliberately NOT used

hyperparameter_grid._comment: E9 pre-registered LightGBM configuration set, frozen in the Phase 1 audit BEFORE any outer-test result was produced. DO NOT expand or edit after seeing results. All values lie inside the grid permitted by the E9 specification section 8. Config 1 is the specification section 9 default. Configs 2-10 vary one axis at a time from the default (clean sensitivity analysis). Configs 11-16 sample the low-capacity corner, which is where a ~3.6k-row training fold most plausibly wants to live.

rationale: LightGBM did not beat honest V3 on the primary metric (-0.00034100). V3's linear Poisson structure is sufficient for this feature representation.
